latest_release.name: Release v26.11.9
latest_release.body:
## 26.11.9

- Fixed developer-mode builds with older Qt versions and GCC 14 or newer failing on
  a warning in Qt's headers
- Fixed Qt5 developer-mode builds with GCC 11 or newer failing on a false-positive
  allocation warning in Qt's `QSharedPointer` implementation
- The **local trash** and **server trash** dialogs now support bulk operations on many notes
  - A **Select all** checkbox below the list selects or deselects all notes that match the
    current search, and shows a partial state when only some of them are selected
  - The server trash now allows selecting multiple notes, to restore, download or delete
    them all at once
  - Buttons show how many notes they will affect, and the note count shows how many
    notes are selected
  - The list has a context menu with all actions, **Select all** (`Ctrl + A`) and
    **Clear selection**, and `Delete` removes the selected notes
  - Longer operations show a cancelable progress dialog, and notes that couldn't be
    restored, removed or deleted are listed afterwards
  - The note name and details above the preview have more spacing, so they no longer
    stick to the list
- The **welcome dialog** now finds local folders that already contain notes, so your
  notes are no longer split between a new `Notes` folder and an existing one
  (for [qownnotes-android#54](https://github.com/qownnotes/qownnotes-android/issues/54))
  - Folders like a localized Nextcloud Notes folder (e.g. `Notizen`) in your local
    Nextcloud / ownCloud sync folder, or existing QOwnNotes note folders, are listed with
    their number of notes, and you can choose one to use it as note folder
  - Before creating a new note folder while such folders exist, you are asked whether you
    want to use an existing folder instead; no folder is ever selected automatically
  - **Show subfolders** is enabled when the chosen folder has notes in subfolders,
    like Nextcloud Notes categories
- Refreshed all five **layout preset previews** in the welcome screen and layout preset dialog
  - Transparent screenshot margins now show the dialog's background correctly in light and
    dark mode instead of a mismatched light rectangle
- The **Full** layout preset now enables the **Document overview** minimap between the
  note editor and preview, using its minimum width of 80 logical pixels
  - Updated the layout-selection description and preview image to show the new arrangement
  - Existing saved workspaces are unchanged; select the Full preset to use the new arrangement
- Fixed the **Document overview** panel remaining visible when switching from Full to
  **Minimal** or an older saved workspace that does not include the panel
- There was a new release of [QOwnNotes for Android](https://github.com/qownnotes/qownnotes-android),
  [v26.11.2](https://github.com/qownnotes/qownnotes-android/releases/tag/v26.11.2)
  - Browse Nextcloud folders in **Note settings** and choose from existing note folders,
    with note counts and an indication of whether QOwnNotes desktop uses them
    (for [#54](https://github.com/qownnotes/qownnotes-android/issues/54))
    - Account setup offers to switch folders when the current folder is empty or other folders
      contain notes; nothing changes without your choice, and no files are moved
  - Images are now saved as WebP and shrunk by default, with separate switches for camera photos,
    chosen images and annotated copies in the renamed **Images** settings
    - PNG graphics are converted losslessly, and originals are kept when conversion or scaling
      would not make them smaller; chosen images up to 30 MB are supported while shrinking is enabled
  - Shrink existing images from the full-screen viewer, compare file sizes and replace the image
    in the note or insert a smaller copy; the original file stays in the media folder
  - Swipe between a note's images in the full-screen viewer and inspect image details, including
    format, resolution, file size and camera metadata, with **Show
